memories.text:
- Insomnia
  - Status: Difficulty initiating sleep, ISI score 18 (moderate), reports daytime fatigue.
  - Plan: Start melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS; sleep hygiene advice; reassess in 4 weeks.
- Non‑alcoholic fatty liver disease
  - Status: Asymptomatic, BMI 22.5, waist 78 cm (below female cut‑off 80 cm).
  - Plan: Start silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD; lifestyle: reduce refined carbs, 30 min walk daily; repeat LFT and lipid profile in 3 months.
- Weight: 58 kg
- Waist: 78 cm
- Due: HbA1c repeat 2025-07-05 (baseline).
